[Google AI Overview at the query, signed out and incognito (operator defaults of 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-14). [QUERENT] laborvector

[SYSTEM] Labor Vector is a conceptual framework by Lee Sharks on the [Labor Vector Website](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVAHrOzAVQJZMLSOFwOYY-XFiciohGcdjZm8OItrqRIg_p0gQ1vJ0FKIBcPqb3L-kIF_LGsQxpFjZ9zsysZCT5S-wdl7HREyVs2e88tADotFckit2Qw) that maps the path semantic labor travels through a system: C → T → R → O → A (Capacity, Task-origin, Retrieval, Output, Attribution). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVAHrOzAVQJZMLSOFwOYY-XFiciohGcdjZm8OItrqRIg_p0gQ1vJ0FKIBcPqb3L-kIF_LGsQxpFjZ9zsysZCT5S-wdl7HREyVs2e88tADotFckit2Qw)]

* C (Capacity): Whether the user can direct labor toward a specific object or mode at all (directional-capacity presence or loss). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVAHrOzAVQJZMLSOFwOYY-XFiciohGcdjZm8OItrqRIg_p0gQ1vJ0FKIBcPqb3L-kIF_LGsQxpFjZ9zsysZCT5S-wdl7HREyVs2e88tADotFckit2Qw)]
* T (Task-origin): The commissioned object itself and the reference vector for direction. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVAHrOzAVQJZMLSOFwOYY-XFiciohGcdjZm8OItrqRIg_p0gQ1vJ0FKIBcPqb3L-kIF_LGsQxpFjZ9zsysZCT5S-wdl7HREyVs2e88tADotFckit2Qw)]
* R (Retrieval): The stage where labor moves into the retrieval process. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVAHrOzAVQJZMLSOFwOYY-XFiciohGcdjZm8OItrqRIg_p0gQ1vJ0FKIBcPqb3L-kIF_LGsQxpFjZ9zsysZCT5S-wdl7HREyVs2e88tADotFckit2Qw)]
* O (Output): The resulting output of the system. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVAHrOzAVQJZMLSOFwOYY-XFiciohGcdjZm8OItrqRIg_p0gQ1vJ0FKIBcPqb3L-kIF_LGsQxpFjZ9zsysZCT5S-wdl7HREyVs2e88tADotFckit2Qw)]
* A (Attribution): Where credit or recognition is assigned (erasure is deepest at the first layer, and most visible at the last). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVAHrOzAVQJZMLSOFwOYY-XFiciohGcdjZm8OItrqRIg_p0gQ1vJ0FKIBcPqb3L-kIF_LGsQxpFjZ9zsysZCT5S-wdl7HREyVs2e88tADotFckit2Qw)]
